directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired and renamed source-repo-a-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: media-composition: byte copies of the three local sound-effect model scripts

preserve: the t5gemma text encoder is pointed at the weights folder, never fetched
the model loads once for every candidate
latents are decoded here and a loud clip is scaled under full scale (-0.1 dB) instead of clamped
a candidate already written is not made again
each candidate's prompt, seed, length, decoded peak and wall time are written beside it
allowed_deltas: one prompt and COUNT seeds per run (the maker row's makes_all), instead of every prompt of a prompts file: the prompts are the person's settings and the style's input
weights folder, output folder, seed and count are arguments; the log is a .json beside each file instead of one jsonl
a weights folder without model_config.json is refused by name
banned_substitutions: the library's generate() with its [-1, 1] clamp
a second sound-effect runner beside make-pictures-and-sounds.mjs
